ux_attachments_item_document.name: ux_attachments_item_document
ux_attachments_item_document.where: document_id is not null and trashed_at is null

ck_attachments_link_mode.name: ck_attachments_link_mode
ck_attachments_link_mode.value:
("link_mode" = 'linked_url' and "document_id" is null and "url" is not null)
        or ("link_mode" = 'linked_file' and "document_id" is null and "linked_path" is not null)
        or ("link_mode" = 'stored' and "document_id" is not null)

ux_creators_orcid.name: ux_creators_orcid
ux_creators_orcid.where: orcid is not null and trashed_at is null

ux_creators_openalex.name: ux_creators_openalex
ux_creators_openalex.where: openalex_author_id is not null and trashed_at is null

ck_creators_name.name: ck_creators_name
ck_creators_name.value: "literal_name" is not null or "family_name" is not null

ix_documents_simhash.name: ix_documents_simhash
ix_documents_simhash.where: simhash is not null and trashed_at is null

ck_field_values_one_value.name: ck_field_values_one_value
ck_field_values_one_value.value:
(
        (case when "value_text" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_number" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_integer" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_boolean" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_date" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_json" is null then 0 else 1 end)
        + (case when "value_item_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)
      ) = case when "is_blank" = 1 then 0 else 1 end

ux_item_bibliographic_doi.name: ux_item_bibliographic_doi
ux_item_bibliographic_doi.where: doi is not null and item_trashed_at is null

ux_item_bibliographic_citation_key.name: ux_item_bibliographic_citation_key
ux_item_bibliographic_citation_key.where: citation_key is not null and item_trashed_at is null

ck_item_bibliographic_pages.name: ck_item_bibliographic_pages
ck_item_bibliographic_pages.value: "page_last" is null or "page_first" is null or "page_last" >= "page_first"

ux_item_office_asn.name: ux_item_office_asn
ux_item_office_asn.where: asn is not null and item_trashed_at is null

ck_item_office_period.name: ck_item_office_period
ck_item_office_period.value: "period_end" is null or "period_start" is null or "period_end" >= "period_start"

ux_items_source.name: ux_items_source
ux_items_source.where: source_system is not null and source_id is not null

ix_notes_item_id.name: ix_notes_item_id
ix_notes_item_id.where: item_id is not null and trashed_at is null

ux_trash_open.name: ux_trash_open
ux_trash_open.where: restored_at is null and purged_at is null

ix_trash_open.name: ix_trash_open
ix_trash_open.where: restored_at is null and purged_at is null

ix_trash_expires.name: ix_trash_expires
ix_trash_expires.where: expires_at is not null and purged_at is null
